entry.title: Cream Cheese and Jelly Toast
entry.summary: Whipped cream cheese and dark fruit preserves turn crisp toast into a sweet, salty five-minute dinner.

entry.title: Prosciutto Wrapped Melon with Mint
entry.summary: The classic appetizer, upgraded with fresh mint for a bright finish.

entry.title: Tinned Mussels in Escabeche on Crackers
entry.summary: Briny mussels in a tangy vinegar sauce piled onto crisp crackers.

entry.title: Cottage Cheese with Peaches and Hot Honey
entry.summary: Creamy cottage cheese, ripe peaches, and hot honey make a sweet, spicy bowl with plenty of contrast.

entry.title: Garlic Confit Bread
entry.summary: Crisp toast smeared with soft, sweet garlic confit and flaky salt.

entry.title: Udon Noodles in Mentsuyu with Spinach
entry.summary: Chewy udon noodles in a savory Japanese dipping broth with tender spinach.

entry.title: Smoked Trout and Apple Plate
entry.summary: Smoky trout flaked over crisp apple slices with a mustard dressing.

entry.title: Whipped Ricotta with Cherry Tomato Confit
entry.summary: Silky whipped ricotta topped with sweet, blistered cherry tomatoes in olive oil.

entry.title: Butter Lettuce with Champagne Vinaigrette
entry.summary: The lightest, most elegant salad. Butter lettuce with a bright, acidic champagne dressing.

entry.title: Olive Oil Cake with Macerated Berries
entry.summary: A slice of Italian olive oil cake with macerated berries as dinner. Acceptable and right.

entry.title: Store-Bought Pork Belly Bao
entry.summary: Using supermarket char siu pork belly and frozen steamed buns. Restaurant at home.

entry.title: Tahini and Honey Toast
entry.summary: Nutty tahini with honey and sesame seeds. A two ingredient toast that is weirdly addictive.

entry.title: Tteokbokki
entry.summary: Korean rice cakes in spicy sweet gochujang sauce. The ultimate comfort street food.

entry.title: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
entry.summary: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad.

entry.title: Smoked Oyster Toast
entry.summary: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner.

entry.title: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp
entry.summary: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice.

entry.title: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine
entry.summary: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining.

entry.title: Mango with Tajin and Lime
entry.summary: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner.

entry.title: Creamed Spinach on Toast
entry.summary: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous.

entry.title: Overnight Oats as Dinner
entry.summary: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour.
